actor.summary: A performer who passes as other people and copies voices and sounds.

Impersonation.summary: Advantage on Deception and Performance checks to pass yourself off as someone while disguised as them.

Mimicry.summary: Copy any creature’s sounds or speech; a listener sees through it only with an Insight check against DC 8 + PB + your CHA modifier.

athlete.summary: Climbing, jumping and getting up are easy for you.

Climb Speed.summary: Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

Hop Up.summary: Standing up from Prone costs just 5 ft of movement.

Jumping.summary: A 5 ft run-up is enough for a running Long or High Jump.

blind-fighting.summary: Fighting style: Blindsight out to 10 ft.

boon-of-energy-resistance.summary: Resist two energy types and hurl that energy back at a foe.

Energy Resistances.summary: Resist two energy types of your choice (any but Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing and Force); you may swap them after each Long Rest.

Energy Redirection.summary: Reaction when one of those types damages you: a visible creature within 60 ft (not behind Total Cover) makes a DEX save (DC 8 + PB + CON) or takes 2d12 + CON damage of that type.

boon-of-fortitude.summary: Much tougher: 40 more maximum HP and a bit extra on each heal.

Fortified Health.summary: Max HP +40. Once per turn when you regain HP, you may add your CON modifier to it (usable again from the start of your next turn).

boon-of-recovery.summary: Cheat death once a day and heal from a pool of d10s.

Last Stand.summary: When dropped to 0 HP, stay at 1 HP and then heal half your max HP. Once per Long Rest.

Recover Vitality.summary: Pool of ten d10s. Bonus Action: roll any number of them and heal the total. The pool refills on a Long Rest.

boon-of-skill.summary: Proficient in every skill, with Expertise in one more.

Expertise.summary: Expertise in one skill that lacks it.

boon-of-speed.summary: Very fast and hard to pin down.

Escape Artist.summary: Bonus Action: Disengage, which also frees you from Grappled.

charger.summary: Dash farther and hit harder after a straight-line rush.

Improved Dash.summary: Dashing adds 10 ft to your Speed for that Dash.

Charge Attack.summary: Move 10+ ft straight at a target, then hit it with a melee attack (Attack action): add 1d8 damage, or shove it up to 10 ft if it is at most one size bigger. Once per turn.

chef.summary: Cook food that boosts rest healing and treats that grant temp HP.

Replenishing Meal.summary: Short Rest with ingredients and utensils: feed 4 + PB creatures; each who spends Hit Dice that rest heals 1d8 extra.

Bolstering Treats.summary: After a Long Rest or 1 hour of cooking, make PB treats (good for 8 hours). Eating one is a Bonus Action and gives temp HP equal to your PB.

crafter.summary: A tradesperson: three artisan tools, cheaper shopping and quick temporary gear.

Tool Proficiency.summary: Proficiency with three Artisan’s Tools from the Fast Crafting table.

Fast Crafting.summary: After a Long Rest, make one item from the Fast Crafting table with tools you are proficient in; it breaks down at your next Long Rest.

crossbow-expert.summary: Load crossbows freely and shoot them up close without penalty.

Ignore Loading.summary: Hand, light and heavy crossbows lose the Loading property for you, and you can load one without a free hand.

Firing in Melee.summary: An enemy within 5 ft gives no Disadvantage to your crossbow attacks.

Dual Wielding.summary: A Light-property bonus attack made with a Light crossbow adds your ability modifier to damage, unless you already add it.

crusher.summary: Bludgeoning hits shove foes around and leave them open after a crit.

Push.summary: Once per turn, a Bludgeoning hit moves the target 5 ft to an empty space (target at most one size larger).

Enhanced Critical.summary: Crit with Bludgeoning damage: attacks against that creature have Advantage until your next turn starts.

defensive-duelist.summary: Parry melee blows with a Finesse weapon.

Parry.summary: Reaction when hit by a melee attack while holding a Finesse weapon: AC + PB against melee attacks, possibly turning that hit into a miss, until your next turn starts.
Parry.duration: until the start of your next turn

dual-wielder.summary: Better two-weapon fighting with a wider choice of off-hand weapons.

Enhanced Dual Wielding.summary: After attacking with a Light weapon in the Attack action, Bonus Action: one more attack with another melee weapon that is not Two-Handed (no ability modifier to damage unless it is negative).

Quick Draw.summary: Draw or stow two non-Two-Handed weapons where you could normally handle one.

dueling.summary: Fighting style: +2 damage with a one-handed melee weapon when you hold no other weapon.

durable.summary: Hard to kill and quick to patch up.

Speedy Recovery.summary: Bonus Action: spend and roll one Hit Point Die and heal that much.

elemental-adept.summary: Your spells of one energy type punch through Resistance.

Energy Mastery.summary: Pick Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder. Your spells ignore Resistance to it, and 1s on their damage dice of that type count as 2s.

Repeatable.summary: Can be taken again with a new damage type each time.

fey-touched.summary: Fey magic: Misty Step plus one level 1 Divination or Enchantment spell.

Fey Magic.summary: Misty Step and a level 1 Divination or Enchantment spell of your choice are always prepared. Each can be cast once per Long Rest without a slot, or with your slots. The ability you raised casts them.

choices.label: Level 1 Divination or Enchantment spell (free once per Long Rest)

great-weapon-master.summary: Heavy weapons hit for extra damage and earn follow-up swings.

Heavy Weapon Mastery.summary: A hit with a Heavy weapon during the Attack action on your turn can deal extra damage equal to your PB.

Hew.summary: Right after a melee weapon crit or dropping a creature to 0 HP with one, Bonus Action: one more attack with that weapon.

healer.summary: A field medic who heals with a Healer’s Kit and rerolls low healing dice.

Battle Medic.summary: Utilize action, one Healer’s Kit use: a creature within 5 ft spends a Hit Point Die; you roll it and they heal the roll + your PB.

Healing Rerolls.summary: Reroll any 1 on a healing die from your spells or Battle Medic; keep the new roll.

heavy-armor-master.summary: Heavy armor shrugs off part of every weapon blow.

Damage Reduction.summary: In Heavy armor, Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage from an attack that hits you drops by your PB.

inspiring-leader.summary: Rally the party with a performance that grants temp HP.

Bolstering Performance.summary: After a Short or Long Rest, perform for up to six allies (you included) within 30 ft; each gains temp HP equal to your level + the modifier of the ability you raised.

interception.summary: Fighting style: Reaction when a creature you see hits someone within 5 ft of you; cut the damage by 1d10 + PB. Requires a weapon (Simple or Martial) or Shield in hand.

keen-mind.summary: A scholar’s memory and fast study.

Lore Knowledge.summary: Pick Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature or Religion: gain proficiency, or Expertise if already proficient.

choices.label: Proficiency, or Expertise if already proficient

lightly-armored.summary: Training in Light armor and Shields.

lucky.summary: A pool of luck to boost your rolls or spoil attacks against you.

Luck Points.summary: Luck Points equal to your PB, all back on a Long Rest.

Advantage.summary: Spend 1 Luck Point to give your own D20 Test Advantage.

Disadvantage.summary: Spend 1 Luck Point to give an attack roll against you Disadvantage.

mage-slayer.summary: Break enemy concentration and shrug off mind magic.

Concentration Breaker.summary: A concentrating creature you damage rolls its Concentration save with Disadvantage.

Guarded Mind.summary: Turn a failed INT, WIS or CHA save into a success. Once per Short or Long Rest.

medium-armor-master.summary: Get more out of high Dexterity in Medium armor.

Dexterous Wearer.summary: In Medium armor with DEX 16+, your DEX adds up to 3 to AC instead of 2.

mounted-combatant.summary: Fight well from the saddle and shield your mount.

Mounted Strike.summary: While riding, Advantage on attacks against unmounted creatures within 5 ft of your mount that are smaller than it.

Leap Aside.summary: While you ride it and neither of you is Incapacitated, your mount takes no damage on a successful DEX save for half, and half on a failure.

Veer.summary: While riding and not Incapacitated, redirect an attack that hits your mount so it hits you.

musician.summary: Plays three instruments and inspires allies at each rest.

Encouraging Song.summary: At the end of a Short or Long Rest, play an instrument you know to give Heroic Inspiration to up to PB allies who hear it.

observant.summary: Sharp eyes and a quick search.

Keen Observer.summary: Pick Insight, Investigation or Perception: gain proficiency, or Expertise if already proficient.

choices.label: Proficiency, or Expertise if already proficient

piercer.summary: Piercing attacks reroll a damage die and crit harder.

Puncture.summary: Once per turn on a Piercing hit, reroll one damage die and take the new result.

Enhanced Critical.summary: A Piercing crit rolls one extra damage die.

poisoner.summary: Brew poison doses and make your poison bite through Resistance.

Potent Poison.summary: Your Poison damage ignores Resistance to Poison.

Brew Poison.summary: Poisoner’s Kit proficiency. 1 hour and 50 GP of materials make PB doses. Bonus Action: coat a weapon or ammunition for 1 minute or until it deals damage; the creature it damages makes a CON save (DC 8 + PB + the raised ability) or takes 2d8 Poison and is Poisoned until your next turn ends.

polearm-master.summary: Strike with the butt of a polearm and punish foes entering your reach.

Pole Strike.summary: After the Attack action with a Quarterstaff, Spear or Heavy Reach weapon, Bonus Action: a melee attack with its other end for 1d4 Bludgeoning.

Reactive Strike.summary: Holding one of those weapons, Reaction: a melee attack on a creature that steps into its reach.

protection.summary: Fighting style: Reaction with a Shield in hand when a creature you see attacks someone else within 5 ft of you; that attack and others on them have Disadvantage until your next turn, while you stay within 5 ft.
protection.duration: until the start of your next turn

resilient.summary: Raise one ability and gain proficiency in its saving throws.

Ability Score Increase.summary: +1 to an ability whose save you are not proficient in, max 20.

Saving Throw Proficiency.summary: Saving throw proficiency in that same ability.

choices.label: Saving throw proficiency (the ability this feat raised)

ritual-caster.summary: Keep a set of ritual spells ready and cast one quickly each day.

Ritual Spells.summary: PB level 1 Ritual spells always prepared, castable with your slots using the ability you raised; add another each time your PB goes up.

choices.label: Level 1 Ritual spells (PB; one more per PB increase)

Quick Ritual.summary: Once per Long Rest, cast a prepared Ritual spell at its normal casting time without using a slot.

sentinel.summary: Lock down enemies near you with Opportunity Attacks.

Guardian.summary: Opportunity Attack a creature within 5 ft right after it Disengages or attacks someone other than you.

Halt.summary: An Opportunity Attack hit drops the target’s Speed to 0 for the rest of the turn.

shadow-touched.summary: Shadow magic: Invisibility plus one level 1 Illusion or Necromancy spell.

Shadow Magic.summary: Invisibility and a level 1 Illusion or Necromancy spell of your choice are always prepared. Each can be cast once per Long Rest without a slot, or with your slots. The ability you raised casts them.

choices.label: Level 1 Illusion or Necromancy spell (free once per Long Rest)

sharpshooter.summary: Ranged weapon shots ignore cover, close quarters and long range.

Bypass Cover.summary: Ranged weapon attacks ignore Half and Three-Quarters Cover.

Firing in Melee.summary: An enemy within 5 ft gives no Disadvantage to your Ranged weapon attacks.

Long Shots.summary: No Disadvantage for Ranged weapon attacks at long range.

shield-master.summary: Bash foes with your shield and hide behind it from blasts.

Shield Bash.summary: Once per turn, after a melee weapon hit on a creature within 5 ft during the Attack action, hit it with your equipped Shield: STR save (DC 8 + PB + STR) or be pushed 5 ft or knocked Prone, your pick.

Interpose Shield.summary: Holding a Shield, Reaction to a DEX save for half damage: take none if you succeed.

skill-expert.summary: One new skill and Expertise in another.

Skill Proficiency.summary: Proficiency in one skill of your choice.

Expertise.summary: Expertise in one proficient skill that lacks it.

choices.label: Skills or tools, in any mix

skulker.summary: Sense nearby foes and stay hidden while fighting.

Fog of War.summary: In combat, Advantage on the Stealth check of a Hide action.

Sniper.summary: Missing an attack while hidden doesn’t give away where you are.

slasher.summary: Slashing hits slow foes, and crits throw off their attacks.

Hamstring.summary: Once per turn on a Slashing hit, the target’s Speed drops 10 ft until your next turn starts.

Enhanced Critical.summary: A Slashing crit gives the target Disadvantage on its attacks until your next turn starts.

speedy.summary: Faster, nimble over rough ground and hard to catch.

Dash over Difficult Terrain.summary: After you Dash on your turn, Difficult Terrain costs no extra movement for the rest of it.

Agile Movement.summary: Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage.

spell-sniper.summary: Spell attacks reach farther and ignore cover and nearby enemies.

Bypass Cover.summary: Spell attack rolls ignore Half and Three-Quarters Cover.

Casting in Melee.summary: An enemy within 5 ft gives no Disadvantage to your spell attacks.

Increased Range.summary: A spell attack with a range of 10 ft or more gets +60 ft of range.

tavern-brawler.summary: A scrapper with heavy fists and a knack for improvised weapons.

Enhanced Unarmed Strike.summary: Your Unarmed Strike can deal 1d4 + STR Bludgeoning damage.

Damage Rerolls.summary: Reroll 1s on Unarmed Strike damage dice; keep the new roll.

Push.summary: Once per turn, an Unarmed Strike hit during the Attack action can both deal damage and push the target 5 ft away.

telekinetic.summary: Move objects with your mind and shove creatures from afar.

Minor Telekinesis.summary: Learn Mage Hand: no Verbal or Somatic components, the hand can be Invisible, and its range and leash grow by 30 ft. Cast with the ability you raised.

Telekinetic Shove.summary: Bonus Action: a creature you see within 30 ft makes a STR save (DC 8 + PB + the raised ability) or is moved 5 ft toward or away from you.

telepathic.summary: Speak mind to mind and read thoughts.

Telepathic Utterance.summary: Talk telepathically to a creature you see within 60 ft in a language you know; it can’t reply that way.

Detect Thoughts.summary: Detect Thoughts always prepared; once per Long Rest cast it with no slot or components, otherwise with slots. Uses the ability you raised.

thrown-weapon-fighting.summary: Fighting style: +2 damage on ranged hits with Thrown weapons.

tough.summary: Max HP rises by twice your level now, and by 2 more each level after.

unarmed-fighting.summary: Fighting style: your Unarmed Strike can deal 1d6 + STR Bludgeoning (1d8 with no weapon or Shield held), and at the start of your turn you can deal 1d4 Bludgeoning to one creature you grapple.

war-caster.summary: Cast reliably in the thick of melee.

Concentration.summary: Advantage on CON saves to keep Concentration.

Reactive Spell.summary: When a creature provokes an Opportunity Attack by leaving your reach, Reaction: cast a 1-action spell targeting only it instead of attacking.

Somatic Components.summary: Do Somatic components with weapons or a Shield in your hands.

weapon-master.summary: Use one weapon kind’s mastery property.

Mastery Property.summary: Use the mastery property of one Simple or Martial weapon kind you are proficient with; swap the kind after a Long Rest.
